ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that inside $ \angle AOB$ there are three rays, among which, $OE$ bisects $ \angle BOC$, and $OF$ bisects $ \angle AOC$. If $ \angle AOB = \alpha $, what is the measure of $ \angle EOF$ (expressed in terms of $\alpha$)?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since OE bisects $\angle BOC$, and OF bisects $\angle AOC$,

$\therefore \angle EOC= \frac{1}{2}\angle BOC$, $\angle COF= \frac{1}{2}\angle AOC$,

$\therefore \angle EOF=\angle EOC+\angle COF= \frac{1}{2}\angle BOC+ \frac{1}{2}\angle AOC= \frac{1}{2}(\angle BOC+\angle AOC)= \frac{1}{2}\angle AOB= \boxed{\frac{1}{2}\alpha}$.
